senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) firm, sound; straight, right, upright.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:2">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>אברהם זה י׳ מן היְשָׁרִים</he> this Abraham is firmer than all the firm (angels); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 82:6">Yalk. ib. 82</cite> <he>אברהם זה י׳</he>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 72:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XI, 7</cite> <he>קודם לִישָׁרוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> before they see the Right One of the world, they (the pious) shall behold the faces of the firm (believers); a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְשָׁרִים</he>, <he>יְשָׁרִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>מה ישריין רחמיך</he>, [read as:] <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982:3">Yalk. ib. 982</cite> <he>מה ישרים וכ׳</he>, expl. <he>מה תקיפין וכ׳</he> how strong are thy mercies. Midr. Till. l. c. <he>איזו כת … זו כת י׳</he> which is the highest class among those who will greet the countenance of the Divine Presence (in the hereafter)? The class of the firm believers.

Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 14 … בתחלה ואה״כ נתן לי׳ first the secret of the Lord is communicated to those who fear him (human beings), and then to the firm ones (the angels, cmp. יְצוּקִים s. v. יָצַק); Gen. R. s. 49; a. e.—Fem. יְשָׁרָה, pl. יְשָׁרוֹת (sub בעיניו; with ref. to Deut. XII, 8) [right in the eyes of the offerer,] free-will offerings (opp. חוֹבָה).
Zeb. 114ᵃ י׳ תקריבו וכ׳ free-will sacrifices you may offer (on the bamoth, v. בָּמָה), but no obligatory offerings; ib. 117ᵇ.
<cite ref="Zevachim 117b">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ נינהו</he> they belong to the class of free-will offerings.
Ib. 118ᵃ; a. fr.—סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר the Book Yashar, a lost book (Josh. X, 13; II Sam. I, 18).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:10:6">Y. Sot. I, end, 17ᶜ</cite>
